links.comparator_used: Unaided manual structured extraction by trainees using the template alone
links.outcome: Processing time and extraction accuracy (global quality score and per-tier error rate) for structuring bone scintigraphy reports
links.effect: Total time fell 82.6% for Trainee 1 (80.72 to 14.08 min) and 74.5% for Trainee 2 (110.48 to 28.12 min). Global quality score rose from 4.84 to 4.95 (Trainee 1) and from 4.88 to 4.98 (Trainee 2), F = 14.658, P <.001. Per-tier error rate fell from 3.2% (13/410) to 1.0% (4/410) for Trainee 1 and from 2.4% (10/410) to 0.5% (2/410) for Trainee 2.
links.quote: With LLM assistance, the time required for Trainee 1 to complete the task decreased from 80.72 min to 14.08 min, representing an 82.6% reduction in total duration.

links.comparator_used: Standard general-purpose LLMs under the same prompt: DeepSeek-V3 (non-reasoning sibling), GPT-o3 and Gemini 2.5 Pro
links.outcome: Structured extraction accuracy and cross-center stability on 384 ground-truth lesion entities
links.effect: DeepSeek-R1 total error rate was 3.9% (n=15), against 12.0% (n=46) for DeepSeek-V3, 9.3% (n=36) for GPT-o3 and 14.8% (n=57) for Gemini 2.5 Pro. Its global quality score did not differ significantly across centers (P=.277), whereas DeepSeek-V3 and Gemini 2.5 Pro did differ (P<.001). R1 F1 scores were 0.969-0.989 across the three centers.
links.quote: For data from ZS and XH, the four LLMs exhibited varying performance, with statistically significant differences in global quality scores across models (ZS: P <.001; XH: P =.002), with DeepSeek-R1 performing the best.
